28:t_015:8.en:
$$ミシェル$$
「Thanks for the treat, $$マオ$$!」

28:t_015:9.en:
$$甲児$$
「$$カミーユ$$, $$バナージ$$ and the rest of you, come on over too!」

28:t_015:11.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Just like Master Sergeant $$マオ$$ said. Let's make use of kids' privilege today.」

28:t_015:12.en:
$$スズネ$$
「W-What do we do, $$マオ$$? I... don't have much on me today...」

28:t_015:13.en:
$$マオ$$
「Dammit, a woman's gotta have guts! Everybody, big sis $$マオ$$ will take care of the whole lot of you!」

28:t_015:15.en:
$$マオ$$
「You're on the adult team! I'll let you help me be the wallet!」

28:t_015:17.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「...Well, you heard her, $$シンジ$$. Let's eat a ton!」

28:t_015:18.en:
$$シンジ$$
「...Sorry... $$綾波$$ and I have to go straight back to $$ＮＥＲＶ$$.」

28:t_015:20.en:
$$レイ#pt394$$
「$$碇$$... The $$ＮＥＲＶ$$ pickup has arrived nearby.」

28:t_017:0.en:
$$クルツ$$
「Yes...! Another enemy team wiped out in a row! I'm on a roll!」

28:t_017:1.en:
$$クルーゾー$$
「Don't get careless, $$ウェーバー$$. A gap in your mind can get you killed.」

28:t_017:3.en:
$$クルーゾー$$
(He doesn't let his morale drop even in this adversity. He may have more promise than I expected...)

28:t_018:0.en:
$$アル$$
「Confirmed destruction of the enemy $$ラムダ・ドライバ$$-equipped unit.」

28:t_018:1.en:
$$宗介$$
「It's certainly a powerful unit, but not an opponent we can't fight.」

28:t_018:2.en:
$$マオ$$
「That's right. It means we can do it if we combine the strength of $c.」

28:t_018:3.en:
$$テッサ$$
(But if that unit or other $$ラムダ・ドライバ$$-equipped units were mass-produced in earnest...)

28:t_100:0.en:
$$宗介$$
「I never thought I'd be lumped together with you and treated as a problem child.」

28:t_100:2.en:
$$宗介$$
「But I find it unpleasant to be regarded as a drag on the unit. We'll overturn that assessment with actual ability.」

28:t_100:3.en:
$n
「Understood. We'll do it to protect $$千鳥$$ as well!」

28:t_100:4.en:
$$スズネ$$
(I knew it. With what happened to $$千鳥$$, those two seem to be taking it the hardest.)

28:t_101:0.en:
$$クルツ$$
「Their moves are so stiff, both $$宗介$$ and $n...」

28:t_101:1.en:
$$マオ$$
「They're both serious kids, after all.」

28:t_101:2.en:
$$クルツ$$
「Hey, Sis... That $$宗介$$... He's changed a lot since he started guarding $$かなめ$$.」

28:t_101:3.en:
$$マオ$$
「Yeah. That's exactly why I want to back him up.」

28:t_101:4.en:
$$マオ$$
(Hang in there, $$宗介$$ and $n. You've got us behind you, you know.)

28:t_102:2.en:
$$厚井$$
「Earth is in danger! Let's fight too!」

28:t_102:3.en:
$$郁絵$$
「That's right! Our company's safe matters, but the peace of Earth matters even more!」

28:t_102:4.en:
$$木下$$
「If it's come to this, let's make a splash! A big splash!」

28:t_102:5.en:
$$柿小路$$
「$$木下$$ sure has no sense of urgency at all...」

28:t_102:6.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Don't sweat it, don't sweat it! Let's keep fighting our own way!」

28:t_102:7.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Here we come, villains! $$竹尾ゼネラルカンパニー$$ will take you down for running wild while Earth is in a pinch!」

28:t_102:8.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「I'll definitely protect Mom, $$サチ子$$, $$しげる$$, $$かおる$$ and the others!!」

28:t_103:1.en:
$$正太郎$$
「No, $$オックス$$. They didn't think we were unnecessary. They cared about us.」

28:t_103:3.en:
$$正太郎$$
「You'll understand when you're a little older, $$オックス$$. ...More importantly, there's something we have to do.」

28:t_103:5.en:
$$正太郎$$
「Let's go, $$オックス$$! Together with $$鉄人$$, we'll take down the bad guys!」

28:t_103:6.en:
$$正太郎$$
「We're the ones who protect the peace of Earth!!」

28:t_104:0.en:
$$シンジ$$
(Father... Fighting has broken out all over the world. Why are you just watching in silence...)

28:t_104:2.en:
$$シンジ$$
「I'm all right, $$綾波$$. I won't think about anything unnecessary right now.」

28:t_104:3.en:
$$シンジ$$
「I still consider myself part of $c at heart! So let's fight together with everyone!」

28:t_105:0.en:
$$アル$$
「Compared to a moment ago, this unit's performance shows improvement. The cause is presumed to lie with the operator.」

28:t_105:1.en:
$$宗介$$
「It's because the tension left my shoulders.」

28:t_105:2.en:
$$アル$$
「Educational message. What does it mean to release the tension from one's shoulders?」

28:t_105:3.en:
$$宗介$$
「If you call yourself high-performance, think for yourself.」

28:t_105:4.en:
$$アル$$
「Is it a problem with the bilateral angle?」

28:t_105:5.en:
$$宗介$$
「You still have a long way to go.」

28:t_105:6.en:
$$アル$$
「That applies to both of us.」

28:t_105:7.en:
$$宗介$$
「Understood. Then let's go all out and wreak havoc, like the greenhorns we are!」

ウェーバー.evidence: Kurz Weber's surname (glossary クルツ・ウェーバー = Kurz Weber); Clouseau addresses him by surname

千鳥.evidence: Kaname Chidori's surname; token already used in dlg_2001-2004_00

碇.evidence: Shinji Ikari's surname; Rei addresses him as 碇君; token already used in dlg_2001_01
